spec.query: SELECT cumulative_sum(sum("expected_pnl_post_fill")) AS "Total Tx", cumulative_sum(sum("skew_adjusted_pnl_post_fill")) AS "Skew Adjusted Tx", cumulative_sum(sum("expected_pnl_pre_fill")) AS "Expected pnl" FROM "defi_cefi_arbitrage_post_fill_trade" WHERE ("stage" =~ /^$stage$/ AND "mode" =~ /^$mode$/ AND "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/ AND "network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "is_defi_trigger"::tag =~ /^$is_defi_trigger$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(0)

SELECT cumulative_sum(sum("notional")) AS "YES Taker Notional"
FROM (
  SELECT "yes_price_dollars" * "count_fp" AS "notional"
  FROM "kalshi_mve_trades"
  WHERE $timeFilter
    AND "mode" =~ /^$mode$/
    AND "stage" =~ /^$stage$/
    AND "taker_side" = 'yes'
)
GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(0)

SELECT cumulative_sum(sum("notional")) AS "NO Taker Notional"
FROM (
  SELECT (1 - "yes_price_dollars") * "count_fp" AS "notional"
  FROM "kalshi_mve_trades"
  WHERE $timeFilter
    AND "mode" =~ /^$mode$/
    AND "stage" =~ /^$stage$/
    AND "taker_side" = 'no'
)
GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(0)

SELECT cumulative_sum(sum("realized_pnl_delta_usd")) AS "Realized Pnl" FROM "default_defi_retention"."kalshi_mve_market_position" WHERE ("stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval) fill(0)

SELECT cumulative_sum(difference(mean("balance_usd"))) AS "Balance Delta Cumsum"
FROM "default_defi_retention"."kalshi_mve_rfq_rest_balance"
WHERE ("stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY time($interval) fill(previous)

SELECT cumulative_sum(difference(mean("open_position_value_usd"))) AS "Open Position Value Delta Cumsum"
FROM "default_defi_retention"."kalshi_mve_rfq_rest_balance"
WHERE ("stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY time($interval) fill(previous)
